summary: @or-sdk/flow-templates preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes a 727KB obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs (itself written with hex-obfuscated identifiers) locates or downloads a pinned Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun and executes the sibling file `math_init.js` under Bun via `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit'})`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated file (obfuscator.io-style shuffled string-array rotation `WV8StW(...)MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())`, hex-encoded identifiers `MmgoCP/etDiOOB/JqTtnbZ`, embedded character-code table) whose name has no relation to the package's advertised flow-templates SDK purpose. Routing execution through a freshly-fetched non-Node runtime causes Node-only scanners to never observe the payload's behavior at preinstall time, and the obfuscation plus cover-story filename `math_init.js` is inconsistent with the package's documented SDK purpose. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper install-time-RCE fingerprint: default `npm install` fetches an alternate runtime and executes an opaque bundled blob unrelated to the package's advertised function.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
